mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing sacubitril and its active metabolite (sacubitrilat) concentrations; sacubitril is also a substrate for organic anion transporter inhibition by cimetidine.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function closely; consider H2-receptor alternative (famotidine) or proton pump inhibitor if cimetidine must be used; assess for increased hypotension or hyperkalemia.
